import sys
from itertools import permutations

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split('\n')
    shuffled = input[0]
    substring = input[1]
    k = len(shuffled) - len(substring)
    n_length = int(shuffled[-k:])
    candidates = set()
    for perm in permutations(shuffled[:-k]):
        candidate = ''.join(perm)
        if substring in candidate:
            candidates.add(candidate)
    result = min(candidates)
    print(result)

main()
